characters.name: K’liira
characters.arc:
novice priestess — wants to hear her goddess again —  — — age: 19
Active Arc: During the Trial of Whispers, K’liira deliberately breaks her vow of silence to expose the High Priestess’s corruption, driving the climax forward without prior warning.

characters.name: Vesryn
characters.arc:
rival acolyte from House Do’Urden — wants K’liira’s position —  — — age: 21
Active Arc: Vesryn sabotages K’liira’s ritual supplies during the Second Descent, forcing K’liira to improvise with dangerous magic, escalating the threat independently of K’liira’s plans.

characters.name: Matron Malice
characters.arc:
High Priestess of House Do’Urden — wants absolute control —  — — age: 45
Active Arc: Matron Malice orders the execution of a slave child to test K’liira’s loyalty, creating the moral dilemma that defines the midpoint crisis.

characters.name: Zaknafein’s Shadow
characters.arc:
ancient spirit guide — wants redemption —  — — age: unknown
Active Arc: The spirit manifests during the First Descent to block a trap meant for K’liira, revealing the existence of a hidden path that changes the plot’s direction.

characters.name: Drizzt’s Echo
characters.arc:
rogue drow ranger — wants freedom —  — — age: 30
Active Arc: Drizzt’s Echo intercepts an assassin sent by Vesryn in Chapter 8, saving K’liira but revealing his presence to the House guards, raising the stakes.

settings.name: House Do’Urden Temple
settings.description: a cavern of obsidian and blood-stained silk, smelling of iron and ozone.

settings.name: The Acid Lake
settings.description: a bubbling expanse of green sludge, radiating intense heat and stench of sulfur.

settings.name: The Web of Whispers
settings.description: a network of underground tunnels lined with glowing fungi, sounding like distant weeping.

settings.name: The Mirror Chamber
settings.description: a room of polished basalt reflecting distorted heat signatures, feeling cold and oppressive.

plot_points.description: K’liira hears a prayer from a dying slave, ignoring the goddess’s silence.
Vesryn challenges K’liira’s piety during a public ritual.
K’liira refuses the blood sacrifice, causing a magical backlash.
Matron Malice orders the slave child’s execution to test K’liira.
The ancient spirit reveals the hidden path during the Third Descent.
K’liira breaks her vow in the Trial of Whispers to save the child.

voice: Close third-person limited, shifting between K’liira and her rival, with a focus on thermal imagery and tactile sensations.
